name: What is the best paint finish for interior doors?

mainEntity.name: What is the best paint finish for interior doors?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best paint finish for interior doors is semi-gloss or satin enamel. Interior doors receive frequent hand contact, bumps, and cleaning, so flat or matte finishes are not recommended because they scuff easily and absorb oils. A semi-gloss provides high durability and wipes clean easily, making it great for high-traffic hallways and kids' rooms. Satin offers a slightly softer sheen while still giving you sufficient moisture and wash resistance. Choosing between them usually depends on matching the sheen of your baseboards and casing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Semi-gloss or satin enamel is best for interior doors because both resist scuffs, handle repeated cleaning, and match standard trim work.
